fields.description: Issue features editorials and local reporting focused on Miami Beach gambling policy and its economic impact, including discussion of Miami Beach council politics and press influence. Coverage includes a Hialeah "Peeping Tom" court case and commentary on law enforcement and public morality, a call for a referendum on Dade County’s school term length, and discussion of rent decontrol legislation. Additional items include a physician’s response to a disputed medical bill and hospital treatment, commentary on immigration policy regarding Finnish arrivals, summaries of Florida legislative actions and advertising appropriations, and assorted letters, columns, and local notices.
